wrong_password: Wrong password, or no file in this folder uses it
not_encrypted_tree: No encrypted files found in this folder
tree_partial_failure: {{failed}} files could not be rewritten ({{changed}} succeeded). The ones that did are valid; fix the cause and run again to finish the rest.
tree_not_supported: Encrypted folders do not support recovery codes yet. Every file in a tree carries its own key slots, and whether a tree should share one code or hold one each is still undecided — set one on an individual file instead.
recovery_mismatch: The words themselves are fine, but they do not open this file — they may belong to a different file, or to an earlier code.
rewrite_verify_failed: The rewritten file could not be opened with the new password; nothing was changed
bad_salt: The salt in the file header is malformed; the file may be damaged
no_vault_found: No encrypted files found in this folder
read_failed: Cannot read it — no permission, or the file is in use
write_failed: Cannot write — no permission, or the disk is full
io_error: Cannot read this folder, possibly no permission
no_omy_file_found: No omy encrypted files found in this folder
file_not_found: File not found; it may have been moved or deleted
empty_selection: Select the files to encrypt first
folder_not_supported: Encrypting folders is not supported yet
delete_failed: Encrypted, but the original file could not be deleted
trash_not_supported: Encrypted, but moving to trash is not implemented; the original was kept
unsupported: This platform does not support that
no_store_path: Cannot determine where to keep the device store
store_save_failed: Could not save the device store
bad_device_name: Invalid device name or pairing code
pair_failed: Pairing failed: wrong or expired code, or the other side is not omy
connect_failed: Could not reach the device. Check the address and network.
media_error_3: Decoding failed; the file may be damaged
media_error_4: This format cannot be played in the app
auth_expired: Authorization for this device has expired; pair again.
peer_not_found: Device not found on the network. Make sure sharing is on.
unauthorized: The device refused the connection; it may have revoked access.
remote_error: The device returned an error. Try again.
verify_failed: Post-encryption self-check failed; nothing was saved. Please report this.
open_failed: Couldn't open this file — there may be no associated app.
unknown_file: This file is no longer available. Try refreshing.
container_failed: Could not read the folder contents
same_password: The new password is the same as the current one
unexpected_new_password: This action does not take a new password
not_encrypted: This is not an omy encrypted file
corrupted: The file is damaged or has been tampered with
not_a_tree: No encrypted files were found in this folder; it may not be an encrypted folder.
tree_only_change: An encrypted folder shares one password across the whole tree, so the password can only be changed, not added or removed.
tree_partial: Some files could not be rewritten. The old password still opens them; run this again providing both passwords to finish the job.
storage_permission_lost: Cannot access device storage. All files access may have been turned off. Please grant it again from the sidebar.
storage_permission_query_failed: Could not check the storage permission state
storage_permission_request_failed: Could not open the system permission screen. Please enable All files access under Settings → Apps → omy.
remote_not_found: File not found on the server
remote_rate_limited: Too many requests, try again later
remote_unsupported: That location does not support this action
remote_container_unsupported: Encrypted folders can't be decrypted to local yet; handle them locally
target_exists: A file with the same name already exists in the target folder; nothing was overwritten
decrypt_failed: Decryption failed; the file may be corrupt or the network dropped
device_key_unavailable: This PC cannot use passwordless unlock (needs TPM and Windows Hello)
device_key_not_enrolled: Passwordless unlock is not set up for this location
device_key_store_failed: Windows Hello could not store the key
tg_login_in_progress: A Telegram sign-in is already in progress
tg_no_login_in_progress: No sign-in is currently waiting for a password
tg_bad_proxy: That proxy address cannot be used. Fix it and try again — this is a configuration problem, not a network failure.
tg_flood_wait: Telegram is rate-limiting requests; you need to wait a while
tg_api_id_flood: omy's built-in application identity has been restricted by Telegram. Retrying will not help — enter your own api_id in Settings.
tg_wrong_password: That cloud password is not correct, please try again
tg_signup_required: This number has no Telegram account yet. Third-party apps cannot register one — use an official client first.
tg_unsupported_2fa: Cannot handle the two-step verification parameters the server returned; please update omy and try again
tg_disconnected: The connection to Telegram was lost
tg_qr_render_failed: Could not render the QR code
tg_login_not_effective: The sign-in does not appear to have taken effect on the server; please scan again
tg_forget_failed: Could not clear the saved Telegram sign-in
tg_no_session: Not signed in to Telegram yet. Please scan the QR code first
tg_session_unreadable: Could not read the saved Telegram session. You may need to sign in again
tg_connect_failed: Could not connect to Telegram. Check your network or proxy settings
tg_session_expired: The Telegram session is no longer valid (it may have been revoked on another device). Please scan the QR code again
tg_register_failed: Could not register the Telegram place
tg_cdn_unsupported: This file is served from Telegram’s CDN, which omy does not support yet. Please download it with an official client
remote_no_search: This place does not support server-side search
tg_broadcast_no_messages: omy does not provide a message view for broadcast channels. Files in the channel can still be browsed normally
remote_no_messages: This place has no concept of messages
tg_tdata_need_passcode: This tdata is protected by a local passcode. Enter it below.
tg_tdata_wrong_passcode: That local passcode is not correct. Note this is the desktop app passcode, not your two-step verification cloud password.
tg_tdata_not_found: No Telegram Desktop sign-in data was found in that folder.
tg_tdata_no_account: That tdata holds no account data; the desktop app may never have been signed in.
tg_tdata_unsupported: That tdata could not be parsed; its format is not what omy expects. You can sign in with a QR code instead.
tg_tdata_io: Reading the tdata folder failed. Check that those files are accessible.
tg_connect_no_proxy: Timed out connecting directly to Telegram, and no proxy is configured. Enter a socks5:// address in the proxy field and try again.
